title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions on this week's biggest stories, from Jerusalem's track to a World Cup final in New Jersey.

questions.question: Blessing Afrifah, withdrawn from the Israeli Athletics Championships with a hamstring injury, holds Israel's national 100m record. What is the time?
questions.explanation: Afrifah set Israel's 100m national record of 10.09 seconds in Jerusalem in July 2025, per World Athletics.

questions.question: Who scored the winning goal as Spain beat Argentina 1-0 in extra time to win the 2026 World Cup final?
questions.explanation: Ferran Torres struck in the 106th minute in East Rutherford, New Jersey, to win Spain the title.

questions.question: After parting ways with Maccabi Tel Aviv, which club did American guard Jeff Dowtin Jr sign for?
questions.explanation: Napoli Basket officially announced Dowtin's signing on 20 July 2026, ahead of the club's first EuroCup campaign in almost 20 years.

questions.question: Who won stage 15 of the 2026 Tour de France to the Plateau de Solaison, his first Tour stage win on a road/mountain stage?
questions.explanation: Evenepoel won the 183.9km stage from Champagnole ahead of Pogacar, while Vingegaard crashed out of the race.

questions.question: Israeli centre-back Stav Lemkin, who battled for a starting spot after a rocky Eredivisie debut, plays his club football for which Dutch side?
questions.explanation: Lemkin joined Twente from Shakhtar Donetsk in June 2025 and made 26 Eredivisie appearances in 2025-26 as the club secured European football.
